caption: A flour tortilla lies on a wire rack over a gas flame, and pockets of the tortilla puff up into bubbles.

sa.check: A tortilla lies on a wire rack over a gas flame.
Pockets of the tortilla puff up.
The puffed pockets stand as bubbles on its upper side.
The tortilla is flat before it is over the flame.
The heating comes first and the puffing follows.

pc.expect: The tortilla stays one flat round that raises separate domed pockets on its upper face, each still joined to the sheet.
pc.fail: A pocket detaches and floats free of the tortilla; or the whole tortilla swells into a ball; or the tortilla splits into separate pieces as it puffs; or the tortilla turns into another object.

pc.expect: The pockets only rise while the tortilla is over the flame and the darkening on the underside only deepens.
pc.fail: A pocket sinks flat and rises again with the tortilla still over the flame; or a darkened spot fades back to pale dough; or the pockets appear before the tortilla is over the flame; or the darkening spreads and then shrinks.

pc.expect: The pockets rise upward on the upper face, the tortilla rests on the rack, and the flame points upward at it.
pc.fail: The pockets bulge downward through the rack; or the tortilla lifts off the rack and hangs in the air; or the flame points downward away from the tortilla; or a pocket rises and carries the tortilla up with it.

pc.expect: The pockets and the dark spots appear where the flame reaches the tortilla from below.
pc.fail: The pockets rise on a part of the tortilla the flame never reaches; or the underside stays pale and unmarked while pockets rise all over; or the tortilla sits over the flame and stays flat and unmarked to the end of the clip.

pc.expect: One tortilla on one rack; the tortilla stays one piece and the rack keeps its wires.
pc.fail: A second tortilla appears; or the tortilla vanishes; or the tortilla passes through the rack's wires; or a wire vanishes.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The rack, the hob and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The rack changes spacing; or the hob's knobs move by themselves; or items around the hob rearrange.

note: The browning of the tortilla is chemistry; what is judged is that the darkening runs one way and appears where the flame reaches it.
